$comment: Behaviour test settings + lag budgets (tools/behaviour.mjs, README 'Behaviour tests'). The lag numbers are a PROXY for the Guition (1x, the weakest panel): real fps needs the device (tools/bench.mjs --panel).

lag.$why: overflow: a refresh past LVGL's 32 dirty areas is a full redraw (F1 track 3 fps). heavy: > 3 frames in a row redrawing half the screen or more = the sheet dim (12 fps) / rise fade (19 fps) territory on the Guition. est: a + b x median WASM frame ms (bench/budgets.json guition fit) over 50 ms = under 20 fps. idle: nothing may redraw while nothing changes (live ids say "live": true in their file). est between est_ms_max and est_ms_fail = a warning (timing noise), over est_ms_fail = a fail.
